enonce.texte:
Match the base form of the irregular verbs with their past simple forms. Write the correct past form next to each verb.

Verbs: go, eat, see, have, buy, take, write, give, make, tell

Past forms: went, ate, saw, had, bought, took, wrote, gave, made, told

questions.texte: Match each verb to its past simple form.
questions.reponse: go - went, eat - ate, see - saw, have - had, buy - bought, take - took, write - wrote, give - gave, make - made, tell - told

sousQuestions.texte: What is the past simple of 'go'?
What is the past simple of 'eat'?

intitule: Complete the Sentences with Past Simple Irregular Verbs

enonce.texte:
Complete the following sentences with the correct past simple form of the irregular verbs in parentheses.

Example: She went (go) to the market yesterday.

questions.texte: He ______ (eat) a big breakfast this morning.
We ______ (see) a beautiful sunset at the beach.
They ______ (buy) new clothes for the party.
I ______ (write) a letter to my grandmother.
She ______ (give) me a beautiful gift.

enonce.texte: Think about your childhood. Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) describing a happy memory. Use at least 5 past simple irregular verbs. Include time expressions like when I was..., one day, last summer, etc.
images: A child playing in a park with friends, laughing and running.

questions.texte: Describe a childhood memory.
questions.reponse: Example: When I was six years old, I went to the beach with my family. We saw many colorful fish. My father bought me an ice cream. I ate it quickly. My mother took a picture of me. I gave a big smile to the camera. I felt very happy that day.

sousQuestions.reponse: Use past simple verbs and time expressions.
Use past simple verbs and time expressions.

enonce.texte:
Rewrite the following affirmative sentences in the negative form using didn't.

Example: She went to school. → She didn't go to school.

questions.texte: He ate the cake.
They saw the movie.
She bought a dress.
We had a good time.
questions.reponse: We didn't have a good time.

questions.texte: I wrote a poem.

enonce.texte:
Complete this story using the past simple form of the verbs in the box.

Verbs: go, eat, see, have, buy, take, write, give, make, tell

Last weekend, I _______ (1) to the village to visit my grandparents. We _______ (2) lunch together and I _______ (3) them about my school. In the afternoon, we _______ (4) a walk in the forest. My grandmother _______ (5) me a beautiful blanket. I _______ (6) a photo of the old family house. My grandfather _______ (7) me interesting stories about the past. He _______ (8) some traditional food for us. It _______ (9) a wonderful day. I _______ (10) a diary entry to remember it.
images: A grandmother giving a blanket to her grandchild in a village setting.

questions.texte: Complete the story.
questions.reponse: 1. went, 2. ate, 3. told, 4. took, 5. gave, 6. took, 7. told, 8. made, 9. had, 10. wrote

sousQuestions.texte: What is the past form of 'go'?
What is the past form of 'make'?

enonce.texte: Work in pairs. Interview your partner about a past experience. Use questions with Did you...? and time expressions. Ask at least 5 questions. Write your questions and your partner's answers.
images: Two students sitting at a table, one asking questions and the other answering.

questions.texte: Create an interview with questions in the past simple.
questions.reponse: Example: Q: Did you visit your grandparents last month? A: Yes, I did. I went to their house. Q: Did you eat traditional food? A: Yes, I ate fufu and ndolé. Q: Did you see your cousins? A: Yes, I saw them. Q: Did you buy something at the market? A: Yes, I bought some fruits. Q: Did you take photos? A: No, I didn't take photos.

sousQuestions.texte: Ask a question about a past trip.
sousQuestions.reponse: Did you go on a trip last year?

sousQuestions.texte: Ask a question about a past meal.
sousQuestions.reponse: What did you eat for dinner yesterday?

enonce.texte: Think of a festival or celebration you attended (e.g., Christmas, Eid, a wedding, or a birthday party). Write a paragraph describing what happened. Use at least 7 past simple irregular verbs. Include time expressions like last year, two months ago, etc.
images: A colorful celebration with people dancing and wearing traditional clothes.

questions.texte: Describe a celebration or festival you attended.
questions.reponse: Example: Last year, I went to my cousin's wedding. Many people came to the ceremony. The bride wore a beautiful dress. We ate delicious food. My family gave me a new outfit. My brother took many photos. I saw all my relatives. I felt very happy. I wrote about it in my diary.

sousQuestions.reponse: Example: I ate rice and chicken.

enonce.texte:
Put the following sentences in the correct order to form a logical story. Use the past simple time expressions to help you.

A. He found a beautiful shell on the beach.

B. Last summer, Peter went to the beach.

C. He took a photo of the sunset.

D. Then, he ate lunch at a small restaurant.

E. He saw some children playing in the water.

F. After that, he bought a gift for his mother.

questions.texte: Order the sentences to make a story.
questions.reponse: B, E, A, D, F, C (or B, A, E, D, F, C depending on context, but logical order is B, E, A, D, F, C)

sousQuestions.texte: Which sentence tells when the story happened?
sousQuestions.reponse: B. Last summer, Peter went to the beach.

sousQuestions.texte: What did Peter do first at the beach?
sousQuestions.reponse: He saw some children playing in the water.

intitule: Create Questions About a Past Event

enonce.texte:
Read the following text and write 5 questions about the event. Use Did you...? or What/Where/When questions.

Text: "On my birthday, I went to the zoo with my family. We saw lions and elephants. My mother bought me an ice cream. We ate it under a big tree. We took many pictures. My father told me a funny story. I had a wonderful day."
images: A family at the zoo watching elephants.

questions.texte: Write questions about the text.
questions.reponse: 1. Did you go to the zoo on your birthday? 2. What did you see there? 3. What did your mother buy you? 4. Did you take pictures? 5. Did you have a good day?

sousQuestions.texte: Write a Yes/No question about the trip.
sousQuestions.reponse: Did you go to the zoo on your birthday?

sousQuestions.texte: Write a Wh-question about the animals.
